## Data source

The analysis uses the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) **Outpatient Imaging Efficiency – Hospital** dataset ([dataset ID: wkfw-kthe](https://data.cms.gov/provider-data/dataset/wkfw-kthe)). It contains hospital-level reported percentages for measures including abdomen CT use of contrast (OP-10) and breast cancer screening recall rates (OP-39), along with facility location and reporting-period fields. The charts describe these reported measures; they do not establish why hospitals differ or provide a complete assessment of care quality.

For field definitions, see the [CMS hospital data dictionary (PDF)](https://data.cms.gov/provider-data/sites/default/files/data_dictionaries/hospital/HOSPITAL_Data_Dictionary.pdf).
